findings.subject: command
findings.impact: All reference top-level commands are registered locally.

findings.subject: command
findings.gap: Local recruiter group implements 19 documented subcommands but lacks the reference legacy command `recruiter geek`.
affectedUsers: recruiters following reference README or existing automation that calls recruiter geek
findings.impact: Reference-compatible recruiter scripts fail for the legacy quick candidate info command.
findings.expectedBenefit: Restores command-surface parity for recruiter mode and avoids breaking reference-compatible automation.
findings.recommendedAction: Add `boss recruiter geek <encryptGeekId>` as a compatibility command or explicitly document it as an intentional difference in a follow-up implementation feature.

findings.subject: command
findings.gap: Reference exposes `boss recruiter geek <encryptGeekId> --security-id --job-id`; local CLI has no equivalent command or alias.
affectedUsers: recruiters using quick candidate info
agents or scripts migrated from jackwener/boss-cli
findings.impact: Users cannot run the reference quick candidate info workflow locally.
findings.expectedBenefit: Completes recruiter command inventory and provides a direct migration path for reference users.
findings.recommendedAction: Implement a compatibility command backed by the local resume/candidate-detail flow, preserving `--security-id` and `--job-id` options where possible.

findings.subject: output_mode
findings.gap: Reference supports `--yaml` structured output on commands decorated with structured_output_options and auto-YAML for non-TTY stdout; local CLI supports JSON envelopes only.
affectedUsers: AI agents expecting YAML output
users piping non-TTY output from the reference CLI
findings.impact: Machine-readable compatibility is incomplete even when command names match.
findings.expectedBenefit: Restores agent-friendly output mode parity and enables downstream tools to consume either JSON or YAML like the reference.
findings.recommendedAction: Add YAML output support, decide whether to match non-TTY auto-YAML, and update help/tests for structured output behavior.

findings.subject: option
findings.gap: Reference uses `--cookie-source`; local CLI uses `--browser` plus local-only `--cookie-path` and `--profile`.
affectedUsers: users copying reference authentication commands
migration scripts using --cookie-source
findings.impact: The same authentication workflow exists but the reference flag fails locally.
findings.expectedBenefit: Improves auth migration compatibility while preserving richer local browser selection options.
findings.recommendedAction: Add `--cookie-source` as an alias for `--browser` or document the rename as an intentional compatibility deviation.

findings.subject: behavior
findings.gap: Reference `boss login` auto-extracts browser cookies and falls back to QR login. Local default login reports failure when browser-cookie extraction does not produce a verifiable session and instructs the user to run `--qrcode` or `--web` separately.
affectedUsers: first-time users
users on systems where browser cookie extraction is unavailable
findings.impact: Default login parity is incomplete and can block initial authentication.
findings.expectedBenefit: A reference-compatible default login flow would reduce manual retries and match documented behavior.
findings.recommendedAction: Plan a follow-up auth feature to either implement QR fallback in default login or explicitly classify the behavior as intentional.
findings.liveVerificationCondition: Needs a testable browser/QR environment and a BOSS account to verify full end-to-end fallback behavior.

findings.subject: behavior
findings.gap: Local `--web` is a local extension not present in the reference. User reports it opens or instructs browser login but does not complete cookie recovery when the browser is already logged in.
affectedUsers: local users relying on browser-page login recovery
findings.impact: The local extension cannot be claimed as a reliable auth alternative until cookie recovery completion is verified.
findings.expectedBenefit: Clarifies that `--web` should be fixed as a local improvement separate from reference parity.
findings.recommendedAction: Keep as local extension but create a dedicated auth fix to detect existing browser sessions, recover cookies, and time out with actionable diagnostics.
findings.liveVerificationCondition: Needs the user's real browser session or a controlled browser profile with BOSS login cookies.

findings.subject: behavior
findings.gap: User reports local `node dist/index.js history -p=1` returns BOSS API error `缺少必要参数 (code=17)` even though the command surface exists.
affectedUsers: job seekers using browsing history
maintainers claiming job seeker workflow parity
findings.impact: A core personal-center command appears registered but fails live behavior due to missing required request context or parameter mapping.
findings.expectedBenefit: Fixing this would unblock a visible workflow and provide concrete evidence for behavior parity.
findings.recommendedAction: Plan a follow-up behavior fix to compare reference `get_job_history(page=page)` request context with local `JOB_HISTORY_API` parameters and headers.
findings.liveVerificationCondition: Requires an authenticated BOSS account with browsing history; no cookies or private history values should be stored in audit artifacts.

findings.subject: option
findings.gap: Reference recruiter search supports `--salary` and `--job`; local recruiter search exposes city, exp, degree, and page but not salary/job.
affectedUsers: recruiters filtering candidates by salary or associated job
findings.impact: Candidate search option parity is incomplete.
findings.expectedBenefit: Improves recruiter search precision and option-level parity.
findings.recommendedAction: Add `--salary` and `--job` options to local recruiter search with request parameter mapping.
findings.liveVerificationCondition: Needs recruiter account access to verify BOSS accepts the mapped salary and job parameters.

findings.subject: option
findings.gap: Reference recruiter recommend supports `-n/--limit`; local recruiter recommend does not.
affectedUsers: recruiters limiting displayed recommendations
findings.impact: Display control differs, but core recommendation retrieval is present.
findings.expectedBenefit: Completes low-risk display option parity.
findings.recommendedAction: Add `-n/--limit` as a display-only option.

findings.subject: option
findings.gap: Reference recruiter greet supports `--job` to associate an encryptJobId. Local recruiter greet exposes a local-only `--message` option but no `--job`.
affectedUsers: recruiters greeting candidates for a specific job
findings.impact: The local greet workflow may lack the reference request context needed for job-specific candidate interactions.
findings.expectedBenefit: Better recruiter workflow parity and clearer request context.
findings.recommendedAction: Add `--job` and verify whether `--message` should remain a local extension.
findings.liveVerificationCondition: Needs recruiter account and candidate id to validate the job-associated greet request.

findings.subject: option
findings.gap: Reference batch-view supports salary, exp, degree, job, dry-run, and yes options; local only supports city, count, and json.
affectedUsers: recruiters previewing or safely limiting batch candidate views
findings.impact: Safety confirmation and filter parity are incomplete for an action that can notify candidates.
findings.expectedBenefit: Restores safer and more precise batch-view behavior.
findings.recommendedAction: Add missing filters and safety options, especially `--dry-run` and `--yes`.
findings.liveVerificationCondition: Needs recruiter account to verify candidate-view side effects without exposing private candidate data.

findings.subject: option
findings.gap: Reference inbox supports `--label` and `-n/--limit`; local supports job and page but not label/limit.
affectedUsers: recruiters filtering inbox by label or limiting displayed rows
findings.impact: Inbox retrieval exists, but display/filter compatibility is incomplete.
findings.expectedBenefit: Improves recruiter inbox usability and option completeness.
findings.recommendedAction: Add `--label` and `-n/--limit` or document the difference.
findings.liveVerificationCondition: Needs recruiter account with inbox labels to verify label filtering.

findings.subject: behavior
findings.gap: Reference asks for confirmation before sending a candidate message unless `--yes` is supplied. Local recruiter reply sends without a confirmation option.
affectedUsers: recruiters sending candidate messages
operators using agent-driven commands
findings.impact: Safety confirmation parity is missing for a side-effectful messaging action.
findings.expectedBenefit: Reduces accidental candidate messages and matches reference safety semantics.
findings.recommendedAction: Add `-y/--yes` and interactive confirmation in non-JSON mode; require explicit confirmation behavior in JSON/agent contexts.

findings.subject: option
findings.gap: Reference recruiter chat uses `-n/--count`; local uses `-p/--page` with pageSize 20.
affectedUsers: recruiters expecting reference chat history pagination semantics
findings.impact: Chat history can be read, but option semantics differ.
findings.expectedBenefit: Improves compatibility for scripts that request a specific message count.
findings.recommendedAction: Add `-n/--count` or document `--page` as an intentional local behavior.

findings.subject: option
findings.gap: Reference invite-interview supports `--address`, `--time`, and `--desc`; local only requires `--job` and `--yes`.
affectedUsers: recruiters creating interview invitations from the CLI
findings.impact: Local invitations may be less complete or incompatible with reference command usage.
findings.expectedBenefit: Restores full interview invite command parity.
findings.recommendedAction: Add address/time/description options and map them to the local interview invite request.
findings.liveVerificationCondition: Needs recruiter account and controlled candidate/job identifiers to verify interview side effects.

findings.subject: option
findings.gap: Reference resume supports `--job` and `--security-id`; local resume only accepts the candidate id and json flag.
affectedUsers: recruiters viewing candidate resumes that require job/security context
findings.impact: The local resume command may fail or return incomplete data for candidates requiring additional request context.
findings.expectedBenefit: Improves live recruiter resume compatibility.
findings.recommendedAction: Add optional `--job` and `--security-id` and mirror reference fallback lookup behavior.
findings.liveVerificationCondition: Needs recruiter account and candidate context to verify request parameters.

findings.subject: option
findings.gap: Reference resume-download supports `--security-id`; local does not.
affectedUsers: recruiters downloading resumes for candidates requiring securityId context
findings.impact: Download can work for simpler cases but lacks one reference context option.
findings.expectedBenefit: Completes resume-download option parity.
findings.recommendedAction: Add optional `--security-id` and pass it through to the candidate detail request.
findings.liveVerificationCondition: Needs recruiter account and candidate context to verify request parameters.

findings.subject: option
findings.gap: Reference recruiter export supports filtering by `--job`; local recruiter export does not expose a job filter.
affectedUsers: recruiters exporting candidates for a specific job
findings.impact: Export exists but cannot match reference job-scoped output.
findings.expectedBenefit: Improves export compatibility and reduces manual filtering.
findings.recommendedAction: Add `--job` to local recruiter export and pass it to the candidate source query.
findings.liveVerificationCondition: Needs recruiter account with multiple jobs to verify filtering.

findings.subject: option
findings.gap: Local job seeker search/export mostly cover reference filters, but defaults and choices are not enforced like the Click reference; batch-greet lacks `-c` short alias for city.
affectedUsers: users relying on strict choice validation or exact short aliases
findings.impact: Core filtering works, but help and validation parity are not exact.
findings.expectedBenefit: Tightens compatibility and reduces invalid request parameters.
findings.recommendedAction: Add explicit choice validation or document commander free-form behavior; add `-c` alias to batch-greet city if desired.

findings.subject: output_mode
findings.impact: Local schema.ts emits `{ok, schema_version, data}` and `{ok:false, schema_version, data:null, error}` envelopes matching the reference contract shape.

findings.subject: behavior
findings.impact: Local human-readable progress is written to stderr and JSON envelopes are written to stdout in JSON mode, matching the reference agent-friendly separation.

findings.subject: alias
findings.gap: Local CLI adds `hr` as an alias for `recruiter`; the reference does not document this alias.
affectedUsers: local users preferring shorter recruiter command
findings.impact: This is a local extension, not a reference parity gap.
findings.expectedBenefit: Documents the extension so it is not mistaken for missing or conflicting reference behavior.
findings.recommendedAction: Keep as an intentional local improvement unless future compatibility policy forbids extra aliases.

findings.subject: option
findings.gap: Local CLI adds browser-page login and lower-level browser/profile selection options beyond the reference `--cookie-source` interface.
affectedUsers: local users needing explicit profile or cookie database selection
findings.impact: The extra options are useful local extensions but should not hide the missing `--cookie-source` compatibility alias.
findings.expectedBenefit: Separates deliberate local improvements from reference compatibility gaps.
findings.recommendedAction: Keep the local options, add compatibility docs/tests, and separately fix or classify `--web` reliability.

findings.subject: option
findings.gap: Local recruiter greet adds `--message`; reference greet instead uses `--job` request context.
affectedUsers: local recruiters wanting custom greeting text
findings.impact: The option may be useful, but it is not a substitute for the reference `--job` option.
findings.expectedBenefit: Clarifies local-only extension status for future product decisions.
findings.recommendedAction: Keep if supported by the live API, but add separate `--job` compatibility support.
findings.liveVerificationCondition: Needs recruiter account to verify whether custom greeting messages are accepted by BOSS APIs.
